title: Bixie Soldiers

wiki.title: Bixie Soldier
wiki.text:
The Bixie Soldier is an enemy bixie NPC that can be found in Queensfields along the two bixie groups of pikemen and battlemages. Most bixie soldiers are Difficulty 1 enemies.
Category:NPC
Category:Enemies
Category:Males
Category:Bixie
Category:Sanctuary
